Class MeshtasticProtocolRuntime

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.protocol.meshtastic.MeshtasticProtocolRuntime
All Implemented Interfaces:
ProtocolRuntime<DeviceState>, AutoCloseable
public final class MeshtasticProtocolRuntime extends Object implements ProtocolRuntime<DeviceState>
Runtime services for one Meshtastic connection.

Combines the Meshtastic protocol handler, DeviceState, incoming message processing, config exchange, and MQTT proxy. This lets ConnectionManager manage only the transport lifecycle while Meshtastic-specific behavior stays in one adapter.

    • prepareForReconnectHandoff

      public void prepareForReconnectHandoff()
      Prepares the runtime for an expected disconnect during reboot/reconnect.

      Meshtastic currently needs this to stop the MQTT proxy before handing control back to the normal auto-reconnect flow.
